verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical straight shrinks of the original into a 320x50 strip. The logo wordmark, the subline and the CTA label are a few pixels tall and can't be read, and the products are crammed against the right edge with the circle cropped. A centres the headline and subline away from the logo, so they don't share a left edge. B keeps logo, headline and subline on one left axis like the original, which makes it slightly tidier.
